suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on the first try, no rollback needed.
I'm thankful for the five minutes of quiet before Fajr when the house is still dark.
I'm grateful for a cup of teh tarik that actually hit right after a long day of meetings.
I'm thankful for the rain that cooled things down on the walk back from the mamak.
I'm grateful for finally spotting the off-by-one bug that had me stuck since lunch.
I'm thankful for a paycheck that clears on time, every time, even when the month feels tight.
I'm grateful for my mum's cooking waiting for me when I go back on weekends.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that saved me from shipping a real mess.
I'm grateful for the aircon finally kicking in after a brutal commute.
I'm thankful for a teammate who actually explains things instead of just linking docs.
I'm grateful for a Friday where the masjid isn't packed and I get a spot near the front.
I'm thankful for CI going green without me having to re-run it three times.
I'm grateful for a long weekend that lines up with no on-call duty.
I'm thankful for my dad still calling just to ask if I've eaten.
I'm grateful for a quiet Sunday with nothing on the calendar and nowhere to be.
